BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Lats
SECONDARY
Triceps, Core

Instructions

Preparation: Use two high cable handles; start with a light load. Stand tall with feet planted and handles around shoulder height. Keep a small, steady bend in both elbows.

1

Start with handles around shoulder height.

2

Brace your torso; keep elbows softly fixed.

3

Sweep your upper arms toward your sides.

4

Finish near thighs without leaning back.

5

Let the handles rise under control.

6

Keep your stance steady before repeating.

Watch out

Pull through your upper arms while keeping your torso steady.

COMMON MISTAKES

Turning the movement into an elbow-bending pulldown.
Leaning back or swinging to move the load.
Letting the weight stacks drop on the return.
